name: bank-manipulation
source:
Load "data.abk"
Reserve As Work 6,7
Print Length(5),Length(6)
Bank Swap 5,6
Print Length(5),Length(6)
Bank Shrink 6 To 2
Print Length(6)
Bank Swap 6,9
Print Length(6),Length(9)
Erase Temp
Print Length(5),Length(9)
Bank Swap 1,10
Print Length(1),Length(10)
Bank Swap 1,10
Print Length(1),Length(10)

encoding.notes: Explicit original token offsets Bank Swap=0x2498, Bank Shrink=0x2a9c, To=0x0094, Length=0x014c and existing Load/Reserve/Erase offsets. Independent payload/line assembly, generic file bytes and image-banks.hex trailer; no production token table or encoder.

evidence.notes: Swap exchanges bank numbers only, retaining type and permanent/data flags; a single present bank is renamed to the absent slot. Shrink accepts positive generic lengths no greater than current size. Image banks can move away from and back to slot 1 while retaining image-slot Length. Values are source-derived, not captured AMOS execution. Null-pointer behavior for two absent swap operands, raw addresses and physical allocation timing are not modeled.
